definition: How directly the method supports SR-C1/SR-C2/SR-C3 and their required evidence.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: Paper 1 is claim-bounded; method depth must follow claim burden.
not_a_selection_rule: More steps/tools is not automatically better.

definition: Ability to preserve claim-critical distinctions and identity conditions.
Ability to link source evidence to semantic decisions and later claims.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: Needed for reproducibility and defensible novelty.
not_a_selection_rule: Citation count alone is not enough.

definition: Ability to test categories/identity/roles/events/states against a foundational ontology.
not_a_selection_rule: Using OntoUML notation alone does not prove correctness.

definition: Ability to produce machine-checkable artifacts and constraints.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: Needed for formal correctness and CQ regression.
not_a_selection_rule: A parser/reasoner PASS is not semantic validity.

definition: Ability to separate open-world ontology semantics from closed-world data/business constraints.
not_a_selection_rule: OWL and SHACL are not interchangeable.

definition: Ability to map real register/data schemas without schema-driven ontology errors.
Ability to support claim-dependent verification/validation rather than a single quality score.
not_a_selection_rule: More evaluation metrics is not automatically better.

definition: Ability to reuse or acknowledge stronger prior methods.
not_a_selection_rule: SemRisk need not dominate every comparator.

definition: Ability to bind exact sources, artifacts, versions, mappings and test states.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: Needed for SR-CL09 and release-bound claims.
not_a_selection_rule: A public repo alone is not enough.

definition: Ability to execute the bounded Paper-1 method within scope/page/time constraints.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: ICAE Paper 1 is bounded; full research program is larger.
not_a_selection_rule: Feasibility cannot justify invalid evidence shortcuts.

definition: Ability to support later Health/Pharma/Risk Intelligence work without forcing it into Paper 1.
why_it_matters_for_paper1: SemRisk is a longer-lived research program.
not_a_selection_rule: Future extensibility cannot expand current claims.
